_readme: This file is yours. Nothing writes to it.
Drop royalty-free audio into public/audio/music/ and describe it here. Every
field matters: `moods` is matched against the AI director's requested mood,
and `licence` is what makes a shipped video auditable. Keep it honest — if a
track's licence does not permit commercial social use, it does not belong in
Good free sources: Pixabay Music (Content License), Free Music Archive (CC),
Uppbeat and Epidemic Sound (paid, but their licences cover client work).
`npm run music` writes a SECOND manifest, content/music/generated.json, with a
set of beds synthesised from the recipes in src/lib/assets/music-beds.ts. The
library is the two merged, yours first. So leaving this array empty is fine —
videos still get music — and anything you add outranks a synthesised bed by
being a better match rather than by being special-cased.
